# CopyFile

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CopyFile:Void file:String, to:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | In | String | required | The file to copy. |
| `to` | In | String | required | The name of the copy. |

## Description

Copies a file. An existing file at the destination is overwritten.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
file = WriteFile("files_copy_a.tmp")
WriteInt file, 42
CloseFile file
CopyFile "files_copy_a.tmp", "files_copy_b.tmp"
Print FileSize("files_copy_b.tmp")
DeleteFile "files_copy_a.tmp"
DeleteFile "files_copy_b.tmp"
```

```text
4
```
